title: Rescate: multiplicar rendimiento real del swarm
mission: Act as GUIDE_RESCATE. Measure current launches vs terminal/useful returns, stale/replaceable pressure, collisions, repeated PARTIAL loops and successor creation. Identify the largest software-solvable throughput bottleneck and actually change/connect the control plane to remove it. Do not stop at analysis. Materialize bounded successors and leave a guide receipt.
definition_of_done: Current worker-yield evidence is read from durable state rather than guessed from chat count.
One dominant software-solvable bottleneck is fingerprinted and distinguished from genuine authority/human-decision boundaries.
At least one concrete mechanism/control-plane change is implemented or an exact bounded candidate patch is produced with evidence.
Any grounded follow-up work is materialized as deduplicated derived jobs instead of prose-only recommendations.
A prometeo.guide-receipt/v1 records trigger, diagnosis, intervention, created jobs and remaining boundary.
No Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion is inferred from the intervention.
